cases.production_SQL: WITH projected AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT m.id,input.ordinal,(v->>'name' IS DISTINCT FROM m.name) AS queue_name_change,COALESCE((v->>'year')::integer,m.year) AS year,COALESCE(v->>'tmdb_id',m.tmdb_id) AS tmdb_id,COALESCE(v->>'imdb_id',m.imdb_id) AS imdb_id,CASE WHEN v->>'description'<>'' THEN v->>'description' ELSE m.description END AS description, COALESCE(v->>'rating',m.rating) AS rating, CASE WHEN v->>'genre'<>'' THEN v->>'genre' ELSE m.genre END AS genre, COALESCE((v->>'duration')::bigint,m.duration_secs) AS duration_secs, COALESCE((v->>'adult')::boolean,m.is_adult) AS is_adult, (v->>'logo_id')::bigint AS logo_id, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(m.custom_properties,'{}'::jsonb)||COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(p.key,p.value) FROM jsonb_each(COALESCE(NULLIF(v->'properties','null'::jsonb),'{}'::jsonb)) p WHERE CASE WHEN p.key IN ('director','actors','release_date') THEN m.custom_properties->p.key IS NULL OR m.custom_properties->p.key IN ('null'::jsonb,'false'::jsonb,'0'::jsonb,'""'::jsonb,'[]'::jsonb,'{}'::jsonb) ELSE NOT (p.value IN ('null'::jsonb,'""'::jsonb,'[]'::jsonb) OR (jsonb_typeof(p.value)='array' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.value)='array' THEN p.value ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) element WHERE element NOT IN ('null'::jsonb,'""'::jsonb)))) END),'{}'::jsonb)) IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(m.custom_properties,'{}'::jsonb) THEN COALESCE(m.custom_properties,'{}'::jsonb)||COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(p.key,p.value) FROM jsonb_each(COALESCE(NULLIF(v->'properties','null'::jsonb),'{}'::jsonb)) p WHERE CASE WHEN p.key IN ('director','actors','release_date') THEN m.custom_properties->p.key IS NULL OR m.custom_properties->p.key IN ('null'::jsonb,'false'::jsonb,'0'::jsonb,'""'::jsonb,'[]'::jsonb,'{}'::jsonb) ELSE NOT (p.value IN ('null'::jsonb,'""'::jsonb,'[]'::jsonb) OR (jsonb_typeof(p.value)='array' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p.value)='array' THEN p.value ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) element WHERE element NOT IN ('null'::jsonb,'""'::jsonb)))) END),'{}'::jsonb) ELSE m.custom_properties END AS custom_properties FROM vod_movie m CROSS JOIN jsonb_array_elements($1) WITH ORDINALITY AS input(v,ordinal) WHERE m.id::bigint=(v->>'initial_id')::bigint), changed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT ON(p.id) p.*,CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM projected q WHERE q.id=p.id AND q.logo_id IS DISTINCT FROM m.logo_id) THEN (SELECT q.logo_id FROM projected q WHERE q.id=p.id AND q.logo_id IS DISTINCT FROM m.logo_id ORDER BY q.ordinal DESC LIMIT 1) ELSE m.logo_id END AS final_logo_id FROM projected p JOIN vod_movie m ON m.id=p.id WHERE (p.queue_name_change OR ROW(m.year,m.tmdb_id,m.imdb_id,m.description,m.rating,m.genre,m.duration_secs,m.is_adult,m.logo_id,m.custom_properties) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(p.year,p.tmdb_id,p.imdb_id,p.description,p.rating,p.genre,p.duration_secs,p.is_adult,p.logo_id,p.custom_properties)) ORDER BY p.id,p.ordinal) UPDATE vod_movie m SET year=p.year,tmdb_id=p.tmdb_id,imdb_id=p.imdb_id,description=p.description,rating=p.rating,genre=p.genre,duration_secs=p.duration_secs,is_adult=p.is_adult,logo_id=p.final_logo_id,custom_properties=p.custom_properties FROM changed p WHERE m.id=p.id AND ROW(m.year,m.tmdb_id,m.imdb_id,m.description,m.rating,m.genre,m.duration_secs,m.is_adult,m.logo_id,m.custom_properties) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(p.year,p.tmdb_id,p.imdb_id,p.description,p.rating,p.genre,p.duration_secs,p.is_adult,p.final_logo_id,p.custom_properties)
